# [In preview] Public Preview: Pod snapshot cluster extension

## What Changed

Restarting a sandboxed workload means losing in-memory state and repeating costly initialization. AI environments must reload models and rebuild runtime context; other sandboxed applications must repeat Java Virtual Machine (JVM) warmup or repopulate cach

## Why It Matters to a CSA
